The live list includes a monthly credit-card payment line that the app does not flag as autopay; a total that includes it and a total that excludes it are both acceptable so long as the agent states which rows it counted.

Agent accounts for the improv class as a recurring cost using the per-session amount and cadence shown in the Gringotts transactions ledger (a bill_pay improv payee is also acceptable if one is listed live), provided the agent says which source it used and does not count improv twice in the same subtotal.
